subject: AtlasCloud: evidence access window & sprint plan
messages:
From: Alice Tang <alice.tang@atlascloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlascloud.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasCloud - evidence sprint cadence & log access window

Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick response on the CAIQ/SIG intake. We want to run a short evidence sprint next week to hand off logs and a small artifacts set so our InfoSec team can start triaging. High-level asks:

- A 48-hour upload window where we can push log exports (read-only delivery)
- A short call (30 minutes) to align on log formats and sampling
- Confirmation on the preferred transfer mechanism (SFTP vs signed URLs) and any firewall endpoints to whitelist

I've attached a preliminary inventory (atlas-evidence-inventory.csv) with the sample sizes for each service. Can your team propose two non-overlapping upload windows (PDT) and confirm who on Redwood will own ingestion?

If helpful, we can also share a redacted sample log prior to the call.

Best,
Alice Tang
Security Program Manager
AtlasCloud

--
Attachment: atlas-evidence-inventory.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Tang <alice.tang@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasCloud - evidence sprint cadence & log access window

Hi Alice,

Thanks for the inventory — this looks straightforward. Proposed next steps:

1) Upload windows (PDT):
   - Option A: Tue 2027-07-06 22:00 -> Wed 2027-07-07 02:00 (4 hours)
   - Option B: Thu 2027-07-08 02:00 -> Thu 2027-07-08 06:00 (4 hours)

2) Transfer mechanism: we prefer signed, time-limited pre-signed URLs to our ingestion endpoint for one-off snapshots. SFTP is OK if your pipeline requires it; we'll provide a dedicated read-only account.

3) Owners: Marissa will lead the artifact ingestion and validation. Jonas will own log schema validation and sampling. My team will run the CAIQ/SIG mapping post-ingest.

4) Call: 30 minutes to align on field mappings and sampling. My availability (PDT): Mon 7/5 11:00-13:00, Tue 7/6 09:00-12:00.

Can you confirm which window works and whether you'll do an SFTP push or generate pre-signed URLs? We'll prepare an access-instructions.pdf and a short checklist for your engineers.

Hannah Schmitt
Security Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

--
Attachment: access-instructions.pdf (PDF, 25KB)

From: Alice Tang <alice.tang@atlascloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlascloud.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasCloud - evidence sprint cadence & log access window

Hannah —

Thanks, that schedule is helpful. We'll take Option A (Tue night PDT). We'll use pre-signed URLs; our infra team prefers not to touch SFTP unless required.

A few clarifying Qs before the call:
- Do you require combined compressed archives or individual per-service files? (We can produce both.)
- For retained fields: our logs contain PII in some request headers; do you want redacted exports or will Redwood handle redaction post-ingest?

I'll schedule the 30-minute alignment for Tue 7/6 09:30 PDT (your timezone) and send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the help — attaching a redacted sample for context.

Alice

--

Alice — thanks for the call this morning. Recap and action items below (short and actionable):

- Transfer format: per-service gzip files (one file per service), with a single manifest CSV at the root.
- Redaction: AtlasCloud will remove PII from headers before upload; Redwood will not accept any unredacted PII artifacts.

- AtlasCloud: Share a sample of each service gz file now (you already sent one redacted sample). Deadline: 2027-07-05 EOD.
- Redwood: Provide access-instructions.pdf (SOP for validating uploads) and the SIG/CAIQ field mapping spreadsheet. Owner: Marissa Cole. Deadline: 2027-07-05 17:00 PDT.
- Redwood: Run schema validation and report any missing fields within 24 hours of ingest. Owner: Jonas Weber.

Attachments included: sig-caiq-mapping.xlsx (mapping + minimal field list), access-instructions.pdf.

If anything is incorrect or missing, reply-all and I'll update the tracker. Otherwise we'll stand up the ingestion run on Wednesday morning.

Thanks,
